title: Jayadratha
style_lock: Premium high-quality charming painted comic / Amar Chitra mythology; warm cream-saffron-gold forest hour; refined linework
style_master_ref: mood: cream-saffron-gold comic (do not attach Ep01 Drona figure plate)
frame: Ornate lotus carved wooden frame on every plate

draupadi.face: Young woman, warm brown skin, large dark eyes, bindi, dignity

plates.beat_text: While the Pandavas hunt, Draupadi keeps the forest hermitage alone.
must_show: Premium painted comic forest hermitage exile camp
Quiet thatch huts, peepal, Draupadi near hermitage
Ornate lotus frame — not bird training scene
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Forest hermitage of the Pandavas in exile, golden hour. Thatch huts, peepal tree. Draupadi in red sari near the camp, alone and calm. Brothers away hunting. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal. Not Drona bird training.

plates.beat_text: Jayadratha, king of Sindhu, rides past and sees her — and desire turns to crime.
must_show: Jayadratha on chariot or horseback spotting Draupadi at hermitage
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. King Jayadratha in royal silks on a chariot on forest road, looking toward Draupadi at the hermitage. Narrative tension, dignified not sexualized. Golden hour forest. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: He greets her with soft words. She answers with the dignity of a queen in exile.
must_show: Conversation: Jayadratha speaking, Draupadi standing proud and reserved
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Jayadratha greets Draupadi with false courtesy; she stands proud in red sari, queenly dignity. Hermitage background. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: When soft words fail, his men seize her chariot and carry Draupadi away.
must_show: Tasteful abduction: Draupadi forced onto chariot, distress without gore or sexualization
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Tasteful dramatic moment: soldiers guide Draupadi onto a chariot as Jayadratha commands — distress and resistance, NO gore, NO sexualization. Forest road. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Her cry reaches the forest. The brothers hear it and turn from the hunt.
must_show: Pandava brothers hunting, suddenly alert turning toward sound
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Pandava brothers in forest hunt — Bhima, Arjuna, Yudhishthira — heads turn sharply toward a distant cry. Alarm and resolve. Golden forest light. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Arjuna and Bhima lead the chase — dust and arrows on the forest road.
must_show: Dynamic chase: Arjuna and Bhima pursuing chariot on forest road
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra action. Arjuna and powerful Bhima chase Jayadratha’s chariot along a dusty forest road. Dynamic motion, golden light. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal, not gory.

plates.beat_text: They overtake Jayadratha. Bhima would end him; Draupadi’s honor is restored.
must_show: Confrontation: Bhima seizes or threatens Jayadratha; Draupadi free
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Pandavas overtake the chariot. Bhima grabs Jayadratha; Draupadi stands free and proud. Dramatic but not gory. Forest road. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Yudhishthira grants a hard mercy — Jayadratha lives, shamed, and rides home.
must_show: Yudhishthira judging; Jayadratha humbled; Draupadi present
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Yudhishthira raises a hand of judgment granting hard mercy. Jayadratha kneels or bows shamed. Draupadi watches with composure. Forest clearing. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: The forest is quiet again — but every insult of exile will be paid in war.
must_show: Premium quality gold closing like Ep01 wide-gold mood
Family reunited at hermitage, quiet resolve
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra closing plate. Warm cream-saffron-gold hermitage. Pandavas and Draupadi reunited in quiet resolve after the ordeal. Peace with steel underneath. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.
